state:
Goal `tools-php-differences`: 1 of the chapter's features is done. `tools:php-differences/arrays-and-strings` has its test, example and attack. The attack carries `// proof: gap nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops`, the endless self-concatenation hang that record describes.
The proofs corrected two rows of `docs/reference/tools/30-php-differences.md` § *Arrays and strings*: `$a = [1, 2];` is `E0301` and only `var` is `E0414`, and keyed destructuring works when every leaf declares its type.
New gap `nvs-host/a-cpu-time-set-at-run-time-is-not-enforced`: `Core\Config::set("cpu_time", …)` returns `true`, but the watchdog keeps the ceiling the request started with.
This feature owes one example and one attack (`bun nv proofs --id`), and no `about.md` or bench.

backlog: `nvs-host/a-cpu-time-set-at-run-time-is-not-enforced`: a raise past the starting `cpu_time` is not checked. It is owned by `crates/nvs-host/src/watchdog.rs`.
An endless `while (true) { $n = $n + 1; }` under `nvs run` is stopped only by a configured `cpu_time`. `wall_time` is not enforced there, as `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md:165` says.
